name: IUB Main Academic Building
description: Houses School of Engineering, Technology & Sciences (SETS), Dept. of Computer Science & Engineering, Lecture Galleries, and Registrar Office.

name: IUB Central Library & Resource Hub
description: Modern multi-story library featuring silent study zones, e-library stations, research archives, and discussion rooms.

name: SETS Computer & AI Robotics Labs
description: High-performance AI Lab, Software Engineering Studio, FabLab, Hardware Robotics Center, and Networking Labs.

name: IUB Central Cafeteria & Student Lounge
description: Spacious student food court offering fresh meals, coffee bar, juice counter, and open-air seating plaza.

name: IUB Multipurpose Auditorium
description: State-of-the-art 600-seat auditorium for university convocations, national hackathons, tech seminars, and cultural festivals.
